_keys_note: Crafter's Discrete(17) map is 0=noop, 1=move_left, 2=move_right, 3=move_up, 4=move_down, 5=do, 6=sleep, 7=place_stone, 8=place_table, 9=place_furnace, 10=place_plant, 11=make_wood_pickaxe, 12=make_stone_pickaxe, 13=make_iron_pickaxe, 14=make_wood_sword, 15=make_stone_sword, 16=make_iron_sword. Default subject keys (adapter): LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN=move, SPACE=do, S=sleep; place/make via a 'keys' override.
